_comment: wave 17 (box conversions, forward half): stbox_to_box3d / stbox_to_gbox. STBox literal in (stbox_in via the stbox_text primary input), PostGIS box out (box3d_out/gbox_out). The reverse box3d/gbox_to_stbox are deferred: MEOS exposes no box3d_in/gbox_in parser to read the operand literal.

operators.comment_one_liner: stbox_to_box3d (BOX3D *) - the PostGIS BOX3D of a spatiotemporal box.
stbox_to_gbox (GBOX *) - the PostGIS GBOX of a spatiotemporal box.
